draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, and Darsen and Ko found preliminary evidence that Patchwise Replay may improve exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher mean exact-match accuracy than RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0%, a 2.4-point gain over 8 seeds), and Darsen and Ko (2023) describe a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages.
rationale: Table T1 supports Asterion's higher mean EM (80.4 vs 78.0, +2.4 pts) with no reported significance test, so "outperformed" is too strong. P1 only describes applying Patchwise Replay in a preliminary experiment; it does not state that it "may improve exact-match accuracy" on Meridian-QA.
